text:
What is the purpose of the split-ring commutator in an electric motor?
A
to ensure that the magnetic field in the motor changes direction every half rotation
B
to ensure that the magnetic field in the motor stays in the same direction at all times
C
to ensure that the turning effect on the motor changes direction every half rotation
D
to ensure that the turning effect on the motor stays in the same direction at all times

options.label: A
options.text: to ensure that the magnetic field in the motor changes direction every half rotation

options.label: B
options.text: to ensure that the magnetic field in the motor stays in the same direction at all times

options.label: C
options.text: to ensure that the turning effect on the motor changes direction every half rotation

options.label: D
options.text: to ensure that the turning effect on the motor stays in the same direction at all times
